title: lobelia alsinoides f. elongata
intro: Lobelia alsinoides f. elongata, commonly known as "Gentian of the Himalayas" or "Blue Lobelia", is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Campanulaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of acting as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia alsinoides f. elongata include stimulating the respiratory system, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
